equality_threshold_rule: Add exact independently enumerated reference probability p as threshold, deduplicate exact rationals. Compute reference before invoking subject.
decision_rule: For target P>=t: yes iff lower>=t; no iff upper<t; otherwise undecided. Equal upper=t is not sufficient for no. Equal lower=t suffices for yes.
correctness_rule: Require 0<=lower<=exact_p<=upper<=1, exact partition enclosure, and all definite threshold decisions equal (exact_p>=t). Refute any wrong definite decision or invalid enclosure; report undecided and execution errors separately.
utility_measures: decision coverage and wrong-decision count per configuration and family role
descriptive subprocess wall time and reference enumeration time
decision rows near exact-reference equality versus other thresholds
interpretation: Finite synthetic model decision support, no empirical proteins or biological validity. No pooled system ranking, independent-sample assumption, significance test, calibrated risk or asymptotic runtime claim.
privacy: Subject source read-only, only fixed local FoldBounds CLI, -B and minimal credential-free environment, cwd/temp artifacts in SVB. No installation, builds, network or production.
